en.iap.title: Support Ombra
en.onb.1.title: Hear it. Then say it.
en.onb.1.body: Ombra plays one short Italian sentence, then leaves a gap for you to say it back out loud. That gap is the whole app.
en.onb.2.title: Start with the text. Then take it away.
en.onb.2.body: While a sentence is new, keep Text: Show and read along. Once it feels easy, switch to Text: Hide and answer by ear. That second step is where the speaking actually comes from.
en.onb.3.title: It keeps going in your pocket.
en.onb.3.body: Nothing to tap, nothing to look at. Lock the screen and keep repeating while you walk, cook or ride the train. Ombra plays right through.
en.onb.4.title: Make it fit your mouth.
en.onb.4.body: Too fast? Not enough time to answer? Speed, repeats and the length of your turn all live in Settings, and you can change them any time, mid-course.
en.hiw.title: How Ombra works
en.cmp.hint:
Say the Italian out loud before the answer plays.
Then repeat it once more after you hear it.
en.hiw.1.title: One sentence, then your turn
en.hiw.1.body: Ombra plays a short Italian sentence, repeats it a few times, then waits. That silence is your turn: say the sentence out loud before the next one starts.
en.hiw.1.s3: A pause opens up. Say it out loud.
en.hiw.1.s4: The next sentence begins. No tapping.
en.hiw.2.title: Text: Show → Text: Hide
en.hiw.2.body: Reading along while a sentence is new is fine, that's Text: Show. But the point is to leave it behind. When a sentence stops surprising you, switch to Text: Hide and repeat by ear alone. Nothing else in Ombra matters as much as making that switch.
en.hiw.3.title: A typical ten minutes
en.hiw.3.body: Pick a course, press Start, put the phone in your pocket. Twenty-five sentences takes roughly ten minutes at default settings. Do the same course again tomorrow: repetition is the point, not coverage.
en.hiw.4.title: The one thing that makes it work
en.hiw.4.body: Say it out loud, not in your head. Repeating silently feels like studying and produces almost nothing. If you're somewhere you can't speak, a quiet mumble still counts: moving your mouth is what matters.

ja.onb.1.title: 音読とシャドーイングで{lang}を習得
ja.onb.1.body: Ombraは短い{lang}の文を再生します。次の文が始まる前に声に出して繰り返してください。
ja.onb.2.title: 音読とシャドーイング
ja.onb.2.body: 初めのうちは音読として読みながらで構いません。しかし目的は、文字を見なくても聞き取れることです。慣れてきたらシャドーイングに切り替え、耳だけで聞き取って真似してください。
ja.onb.3.title: 1日10分でOK
ja.onb.3.body: コースを選んで、開始を押して、スマホをポケットに入れる。同じコースを繰り返し実施しましょう。大切なのは網羅することではなく繰り返すことです。
ja.onb.4.title: 最後に
ja.onb.4.body: 声に出せる環境なら、大きな声で繰り返しましょう。耳と口を連動することが、学習の近道です。マスクをして口パクでもOK。堂々と{lang}を勉強しましょう。
